pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Temporal_Reason: Over 15 frames the pedestrian maintains a consistent stationary stance with no preparatory movements, head turns toward traffic, or behavioral transitions that would indicate crossing intention, and their attention shifts to distracted behavior rather than road-focused awareness.

pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Conclusion: The pedestrian will not cross the road because they remain stationary on the sidewalk, show no interest in the roadway, move only sideways along the curb, and display no crossing preparation behaviors despite the steady approach of the ego-vehicle.
